title: Robin in de Hood
style: Phonk rap with hard-bouncing drums, dusty minor-key synth stabs, and a clipped low-end pulse; intro rides engine revs and police-radio textures, verse builds with sparse bass and sharp callouts, pre-chorus widens into stacked chants and rising noise, chorus hits with gang doubles and a chantable hook, bridge strips to half-time with echoed numbers and a final lift. Close-mic lead vocal, shouted ad-libs on the hook, gritty and wide mix with siren swells and filtered risers between sections., rap, fake, tone, rock, bounce
